body_lead: Staqu Technologies, an Artificial Intelligence (AI) implementation enabler in India, launched its latest AI-powered solution, SIMBA, to enhance the law enforcement capabilities of Nagpur city. The tool is developed in collaboration with the Nagpur police department. This strategic partnership underscores Staqu's commitment to providing cutting-edge solutions for public safety and security, the company said in a press release.Crime GPT, a key feature of SIMBA, utilizes an extensive criminal database to provide results from video, document and audio data.
